definitions.explanation: Describes a collection of different, often unrelated things mixed together without clear organization. Can be neutral or slightly negative depending on context.

examples.japanese: {雑多|ざった}なもの⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいる→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: A miscellaneous assortment of things is lined up.

examples.japanese: ⟦{机|つくえ}→机：00762_tsukue⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{雑多|ざった}な⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{積|つ}まれていた→積む：02294_tsumu⟧。
examples.english: A jumble of documents was piled on the desk.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{商店街|しょうてんがい}→商店街：09391_shoutengai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{雑多|ざった}な⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まっていて→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧、⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{楽|たの}しい→楽しい：00817_tanoshii⟧。
examples.english: This shopping street has a varied mix of shops, and it's fun just to walk around.

notes:
USAGE:
Describes a disorganized or heterogeneous mixture. While it can sound negative (implying mess or clutter), it can also convey a lively, eclectic atmosphere when describing markets, neighborhoods, or collections.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {雑多|ざった}なもの (miscellaneous things)
- {雑多|ざった}な⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧ (assorted information)
- {雑多|ざった}な⟦{人々|ひとびと}→人々：03141_hitobito⟧ (a diverse crowd of people)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{多種多様|たしゅたよう}→多種多様：15329_tashutayou⟧な: diverse, of many kinds — more positive, emphasizing variety
- ⟦{雑然|ざつぜん}→雑然：09236_zatsuzen⟧とした: cluttered, disorderly — focuses on messiness of physical space
